The `updateEvent` function in CalendarManager.ts (not shown creating these fields) returns EventResult which now has `externalId` and `credentialId` fields added in the createEvent function (lines 264-266), but updateEvent doesn't set these fields. The finding correctly identifies that updateEvent doesn't supply externalId/credentialId in its result, so when updateCalendarEvent is called and its results are mapped to references (lines 203-208), these fields would be undefined. This is a real bug where calendar references created from update operations lack routing information.
